## About
Value Auto Clinic does complete auto and light truck care. Air conditioning, brakes, clutches, cooling systems, electrical, engine work, steering, suspension, tires, timing belts, transmissions and tune-ups. If you don't see it listed, call and ask.
The shop is owner operated, so you deal with the decision maker. We give you options and recommendations and let you decide what gets done. Estimates are free. Quality parts, fair price.
You'll find us on Gillham Rd near Crown Center in Kansas City, and on Se Blue Pkwy next to Habaneros in Lee's Summit. 4.5 stars from 171 Google reviews. One reviewer says Jared has always been very informative and forthcoming.

## Services
- Air conditioning work: Air conditioning repair for cars and light trucks.
- Manufacturer recommended services: Scheduled maintenance done the way your vehicle's maker calls for.
- Missouri Vehicle Inspection: State inspection at the shop.
- Potential purchase / Used vehicle inspection: Bring in a used vehicle before you buy it and we'll look it over.
- Transmission service / replacement: Transmission service, or replacement when it's needed.
- No mark-up towing: Towing is available with no mark-up.

## FAQ
Q: Are you open on Friday?
A: The shop runs Monday through Thursday. Friday is by appointment.

Q: Is there more than one location?
A: Yes. Kansas City near Crown Center and Lee's Summit next to Habaneros. Call, e-mail or visit either one for questions, estimates or to drop off a vehicle.

Q: Can I text the shop?
A: Yes. One reviewer says they like being able to text instead of calling.
